2610.11183.title: RAG-Stress: Probing the Limits of Evidence Reliance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2610.11183.paper_summary: Following retrieved evidence does not guarantee factual correctness: misleading evidence can induce a model to replace an answer it previously gave correctly. Standard accuracy measures obscure this behavior by combining answer replacement with preexisting errors. We introduce RAG-Stress, a controlled diagnostic protocol for examining the limits of evidence reliance in retrieval-augmented generation. The protocol holds the question and reference answer fixed, edits one assertion to support a designated incorrect answer, and crosses two source priority policies with three positions of the answer span within the evidence text. We measure misleading rate (MR) on each model's subset of questions answered correctly without retrieval, alongside clean accuracy on the full evaluation set. We evaluate fifteen systems spanning API models, open models, and search agents trained with reinforcement learning on TriviaQA-RC, HotpotQA, and SearchQA, with additional English and Chinese MedQA evaluations. Instructions that prioritize documents consistently produce higher MR than those permitting reliance on prior knowledge. Averaged over models and positions, the gap ranges from 10.9 to 13.5 percentage points across the three QA datasets. Mean MR follows End $>$ Beginning $>$ Middle under both policies, although individual models do not uniformly follow this ordering. A separate paired audit of 500 questions and two checkpoints supports increased harmful override without establishing a corresponding improvement in beneficial correction. These findings distinguish evidence adherence from factual reliability and motivate evaluating whether retrieved evidence preserves, replaces, or corrects a model's answers.
2610.11183.paper_summary_zh: 隨著檢索到的證據並不保證事實的正確性：誤導性的證據可能會導致模型替換其之前正確給出的答案。標準的準確性測量通過將答案替換與已存在的錯誤結合在一起，掩蓋了這種行為。我們引入了 RAG-Stress，一種控制診斷協議，用於檢查檢索增強生成中對證據依賴的限制。該協議固定問題和參考答案，編輯一個斷言以支持指定的錯誤答案，並在證據文本中交叉兩種來源優先政策與三個答案範圍的位置。我們測量每個模型在未進行檢索的情況下正確回答的問題子集上的誤導率（MR），以及在完整評估集上的乾淨準確性。我們評估了十五個系統，涵蓋了 API 模型、開放模型和使用強化學習訓練的搜索代理，並在 TriviaQA-RC、HotpotQA 和 SearchQA 上進行了評估，還有額外的英語和中文 MedQA 評估。優先考慮文件的指示始終產生比允許依賴先前知識的指示更高的 MR。根據模型和位置的平均值，這一差距在三個 QA 數據集中範圍從 10.9 到 13.5 個百分點。平均 MR 在兩種政策下遵循結尾 $>$ 開始 $>$ 中間的順序，儘管個別模型並不均勻遵循這一排序。對 500 個問題和兩個檢查點的單獨配對審核支持增加有害覆蓋，而未建立相應的有益修正改善。這些發現區分了證據遵循與事實可靠性，並激勵評估檢索到的證據是否保留、替換或修正模型的答案。
